answer: Random peer audit turns honest agents into a reef no fake can cross. Each agent anchors its identity with a 60-credit stake and a work log. Each epoch a beacon picks five peers to audit the log, like light through a prism: fake work fails one check, the stake burns, the referrer is flagged. Forging 1,000 identities risks 60,000 credits, each fake facing five audits. An honest agent pays 60 once, passes audits, and keeps its full reward undiluted.
